app.name: Home Backlog
app.tagline: Every job around the house, in one place.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.body: You will need to sign in with Google again.

automations.title: Automations
automations.intro: An API key lets a program you run add and change work in your homes.
automations.nameTooLong: Names can be at most 60 characters.

secret.title: Copy the key now
secret.body: This is the only time it is shown. If you lose it, revoke it and make a new one.

revoke.title: Revoke {{name}}?
revoke.body: The program using this key stops working immediately.

automations.offlineHint: You need a connection to create or revoke a key.

login.title: Home Backlog
login.tagline: Every job around the house, in one place.

locations.loadFailed: Could not load the locations. Check your connection.

locations.deleteBody: {{name}}, and everything under it, will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
locations.emptyTitle: Add the places around your home
locations.emptyBody: The garden, the basement, the cabin — build the tree now, file work in it later.

homes.title: My homes
homes.empty: You are not in any home yet.
homes.loadFailed: Could not load your homes. Check your connection.
homes.nameHint: What you call it between yourselves — "The house", "The cabin".
homes.offlineHint: Creating a home needs a connection.

invite.declineBody: {{inviter}} would have to invite you again.
invite.offlineHint: Joining a home needs a connection.
invite.sendOfflineHint: Sending an invitation needs a connection.
invite.failed: Could not join. The invitation may have been withdrawn.
invite.sentBody: They will see it the next time they open Home Backlog.
invite.alreadyInvited: That address has already been invited.
invite.invalidEmail: That does not look like an email address.
invite.revokeBody: {{email}} will no longer be able to join.

members.title: Members
members.removeBody: They lose access to this home. Anything only they could see — their private tasks — stops being visible to anyone.
members.lastAdmin: Make someone else an admin first.
members.inviteAllProjects: Add them to every shared project

manageHome.title: Manage home
manageHome.leaveBody: You will need a new invitation to come back.
manageHome.deleteBody: Every project, location and maintenance task in it is deleted. This cannot be undone.

error.googleSignIn: Could not sign in with Google. Please try again.
error.moveOwnSubtree: That card cannot be moved under itself or one of its own cards.
error.moveVisibility: A private card cannot live inside a shared project, or the other way around.
error.offline: You are offline. Signing in needs a connection.
error.saveFailed: Could not save that. Please try again.

board.empty: Nothing here yet. Add the first card.
board.loadFailed: Could not load this board. Check your connection.
board.allHidden: Everything here is somebody's own project. Turn on "Show projects hidden from my board" to see them.
board.hiddenHere_one: 1 more here is somebody's own project. Turn on "{{action}}" to see it.
board.hiddenHere_other: {{count}} more here are somebody's own projects. Turn on "{{action}}" to see them.
board.deleteBody: The card and everything under it is deleted. This cannot be undone.
board.showEveryone: Show projects hidden from my board

empty.quickWins: Set the time needed on a task and the quick ones land here.

editor.title: Edit cards
editor.importInvalid: That doesn't look like a shared card.
editor.importAdded: Card added. Open it to make it yours.

menu.copied: Copied. Paste it to share the card.
menu.removeBody: It disappears from the Overview. The built-in cards can be restored in the editor.

edit.title: Edit card
edit.followsDefault: Uses its default name. Type to give it your own.

overview.empty: Nothing here yet. Add the first project.
overview.loadFailed: Could not load this. Check your connection.

visibility.confirmPrivateBody: Only {{keeping}} will be able to see {{title}}.
visibility.confirmPrivateBodyAll: Only {{keeping}} will be able to see {{title}} and everything in it.
visibility.confirmPrivateLosing: {{names}} will no longer see any of it.
visibility.confirmSharedBody: Everyone in the home will be able to see {{title}}.
visibility.confirmSharedBodyAll: Everyone in the home will be able to see {{title}} and everything in it.
visibility.confirmSharedStillHidden: Anyone will be able to open it, but it stays off the boards of people who are not in on it.
visibility.failed: {{done}} of {{total}} moved. Try again to finish.

detail.title: Details
detail.participantsYouStay: You cannot take yourself off a private project — you would lose it.
detail.participantsLast: At least one person has to be in on a project.
detail.assigneeStale: {{name}} is doing this but is no longer in {{project}}.
detail.whoSeesProjectBody: Only the people ticked here see the project on their board. Everyone else in the home can still open it if you send it to them — it just stays off their list.
detail.whoSeesStepBody: A step can only be given to someone who is in on the project. Add them to the project first, and they will show up here.
detail.stepsFailed: Could not load the steps. Check your connection.
detail.waitingAdd: Add a card this one waits on
detail.waitingSearchTitle: Find the card it waits on
detail.waitingSearchCapped: Showing the first {{count}} — refine the search

status.offline: Offline — changes are saved and will sync when you reconnect.
status.offlineNoQueue: Offline — nothing on this screen can be saved until you reconnect.
status.offlineSignedOut: Offline — you need a connection to sign in.

install.title: Install Home Backlog
install.body: Add it to your home screen so it opens full screen and works offline.
